text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Oh, Spe-san! Ufufu, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to think of a good birthday 
present... something special if possible, 
so I've been pondering all kinds of 
things!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Cesario-san, won't you train with me?! 
I'll do whatever kind of workout you 
want!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh, I'm so sorry for giving you such 
a clumsy, rustic present!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Since Cesario-san is so mature, I even 
asked Maruzen-san for advice, but in the 
end, I figured going for a run together is 
the best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
See, when we ran together before, you were 
so happy about it... So I thought, why not 
do it again after so long!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...I'm happy. Your running strangely suits 
me well, and I learn so much from it—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—One can't help but be drawn in. It makes 
you want to catch up.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will secure course reservations 
immediately. The conditions—Turf, 2400m. 
Would that be acceptable?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes! I'll give it everything I've 
got, Cesario-san!
